ANOMALY.

Instrumental prompt engine for Suno v6, aimed at today's hip hop and R&B radio. Every roll is syncopated, human-timed, twitchy, has a beat switch, and carries one signature anomaly.

Style field

Lyrics field · instrumental arrangement

Paste as-is and turn Suno's Instrumental toggle on. Each tag tells the model what the beat does; there is nothing to sing.
